method: Volume-centered v1: rigify-v1 base + 10 anatomically-verified moves to true local volume/tube centers. Limb tubes: median of 5-sample DoubleSide opposing-pair midpoints per axis (12mm sample square, both-walls-required, width caps limb 160mm), multiple axes (X+Z where valid), gap/miss/asymmetric rejection, 4mm deadband. Waist: lumbar vertebral (dorsal abdominal wall +40mm, X symmetric torso walls), gap rejection (rig in lordosis gap). Column/shoulders/hips-femoral/head-neck/clavicles preserved (midline/vertebral/junction anatomy; centroid rejected where hair/arms/gap would bias). Y never touched (Rigify axial heights preserved). Surface markers untouched: headTop (crown), leftFoot/rightFoot (toe tips). Mirroring OFF (right arm +40mm lateral asymmetry preserved).
centerMethod: BVH (three-mesh-bvh 0.9.2) DoubleSide raycasts vs original 691k-tri mesh in root-local meters (uint16*scale+translation, Y grounded): 4 XZ axes (X/Z/D45/D135) x5 origins (center/+Y/-Y/+perp/-perp 6mm) =40 rays/marker, width caps limb160/shoulder-hip250/column500/head-neck300, thin-flake (<10mm) + edge-graze (<2mm vs >40mm) rejection, per-axis median then overall median for proposal, anatomical classification override (vertebral/junction/midline) where centroid would be wrong. Verified island tube positions show symmetric walls (e.g. knee 55/54 +60/59) vs rig gap (4mm wall +Z miss); waist island X 118/87 +Z front123/dorsal45 vertebral vs rig X+ miss +gap Z.
tubeSource: Espacio-de-trabajo-41.island-fit-v1.json (BVH tube scans scratch/measure-tubes.json, tubes-table.txt) + fresh BVH verification scratch/marker-volumetric.json, probe6.json, compare-waist-legs.json
